Name: PoshAcmeExchangeServer
Description: Exchange role of PoshAcme, read by the scripts in ExchangeServer (with Get-ApplicationSettings). The order's domain comes from the core settings (..\Data\PoshAcme.json). A server that needs other values gets PoshAcmeExchangeServer.<COMPUTERNAME>.json next to this file. Bump Version whenever any file of the role changes.

Notes.InternalTransportThumbprint: Stable (non Let's Encrypt) certificate kept as the default SMTP certificate between Exchange servers, usually the Exchange Auth certificate. Empty = leave internal transport alone.
Notes.ExchangeServers: All Exchange servers of the organisation (FQDN); the others get the WinRM tests.
